title: Swap acceptance image to uploaded asset and update app name/share label to myvalentinepiku

requirements.summary: Replace the acceptance-state meme image with the newly uploaded static asset while leaving all other images unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user clicks/taps “Yes” and reaches the acceptance state, the displayed image matches the uploaded image.
No other images on the page are changed.
The acceptance image is served as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated (no backend fetching).

file_operations.description: Add the newly uploaded acceptance-state image asset at this exact path so it can be served statically by the frontend build.

Update only the acceptance-state (rendered when `accepted` is true) to reference the new static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-meme-piku.dim_1024x1024.png, without changing any other images or interaction logic.

requirements.summary: Update the app’s visible name/labeling to “myvalentinepiku” and surface a single share link in the UI based on the current deployed origin.
acceptanceCriteria: Deployment/share URL reflects the name "myvalentinepiku" (as the app/domain label).
A single updated share link is produced for the renamed deployment.

file_operations.description: Change the document <title> to use the name "myvalentinepiku" so the browser/tab and shared previews (where applicable) reflect the renamed app.

Adjust the footer to present the app name "myvalentinepiku" and render exactly one share link derived from the current window.location origin (client-side) for users to copy/share, without adding new routes or backend dependencies.
